comments.author: H.-Gazi
comments.body:
To bring this up to date...

Baltic sea north - You can collect Bauxite which is need it for most industrial productions. For this I assume you need about R14+ collect in order to obtain it. The rate is about 125~175 per hour with field activity 1 + 2.

West Siberian Plain - You can collect Nickle which is need it for most industrial productions. For this I assume you need about R12+ collect in order to obtain it. The rate is about 150~200 per hour with field activity 1 + 2. Not to mention green ore collection rate is good, almost good as South America Northwest coast! So for lazy alchemists, this is your spot!

Kind Regards,

Huseyin_Gazi
